verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at developer.folk.app returning HTTP 200 with a structured developer-portal index. The docs are also served as markdown (.md) pages, and those pages carry an explicit note telling agents to fetch the complete documentation index from llms.txt. Together this gives an agent a ready entry point into the API reference, webhooks and core-concepts docs. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths 404), and no llms-full.txt or independent user corroboration evidenced.
